nodes.text: One qualifying occupation route is occupation by the landlord himself or by a member of his family dependent on him.

nodes.text: For the landlord-or-dependent-family occupation route, the landlord is the owner of the premises.

nodes.text: An alternative qualifying route is occupation by a person for whose benefit the premises are held.

nodes.text: The landlord or such qualifying person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.

nodes.text: Under the supplied pre-2008 residential wording, the ground concerns premises let for residential purposes that are required bona fide for residential occupation through the stated qualifying routes, subject to the stated ownership qualification and absence of other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.
